Visitor skips bold/strong elements

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
visitor = Class.new do
  def visit_strong(ctx, text)
    'skip'
  end
end.new
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Normal <strong>bold text</strong> normal</p>', visitor)
puts result.inspect
```
